summary: Clean kitchen space with minimal hazards, primarily pots resting near island edge.

hazards.title: Heavy pot near island edge
hazards.detail: Heavy cast iron Dutch oven near counter edge could tip or be pulled off.
fixSteps: Push pots and cookware closer to the center of the kitchen island.
Store heavy cookware in lower cabinets when not actively cooling.

hazards.title: Loose cookware lid on counter
hazards.detail: Heavy lid placed separately on counter creates an awkward spill or slide hazard.
fixSteps: Place lid securely back on the Dutch oven or store flat on a trivet.
Move lid away from the front working edge of the counter.
